title: Audrey:
title_short: Reel · Audrey · He Wrote to My Students
headline: One man in a prison workshop wrote letters to a teacher's high school students for five years. His words kept kids in school.
story: Audrey is an FTC volunteer since 2007. She was a high school math teacher for at-risk students. In a workshop a young man told her he wanted to write to her students. He did, for five years. What happens inside reaches people outside. Campaign theme: Why I Volunteer. It is not her life story, the history of the prison, or what the young man did.

Loops: L1 “Who wrote to them, and from where?” opens 0:00 and closes at 0:13. L2 “What did his letters do?” opens 0:00 and closes at 0:35. Stakes: high school students at risk. The letters helped them stay in school.
